responsibility: Declares libgdiagnostics, GCC’s pure C API for external clients to build and emit diagnostics. It defines the opaque manager, sink, file, location, logical-location, diagnostic, and execution-path types; enums for color and SARIF-version policy; attribute macros for API contracts; and the full procedural interface for creating source locations, configuring sinks, attaching metadata and fix-its, building path events, grouping diagnostics, and emitting them.
same_name_distinction: This header is the public API half of libgdiagnostics: unlike gcc/libgdiagnostics.cc, which implements the library behind opaque handles, it defines the C-facing types, enums, attribute macros, and function prototypes for external users of the diagnostics library.
